summary: Submitted the checker_correspondence review of the third scenario for C-append-log-identity-consistency (artifact a1b1304d5b6744abba5e54bede6ae423), status no_issue_found with no open issues and no execution attribution (target test exited zero). The trusted runner executed the fixed harness in a clean copy: vote_precondition recorded cached_index 3 / cached_term 2 against real_index 1 / real_term 1, and vote_decision recorded granted false with the candidate at index 2 term 2, so P-vote-granted was a complete violated witness whose only blocker was the missing correspondence review. The review establishes applicability (the premise is the accepted truncation-then-StoreLogs-failure scenario; the vote request is legal with the node's current term, an empty configuration, no prior vote, and a candidate deliberately chosen to be strictly more up to date than the real log) and observation validity (cached and real identities are read independently and carried by the matched prerequisite; the compared field is the vote handler's own Granted result under the shared node identity). It isolates the cache as the cause because the candidate is not less up to date than the real log and no other vote precondition differs, keeps the result to the vote-facing consequence rather than an election outcome, and transparently notes one harness labelling wart: in the result event the field named real_term carries the LastIndex error placeholder rather than the entry term, while the correct real term appears in the precondition event and the field is not used by the comparison. Limitations preserve the scope (artificial single failure, local vote decision, other vote-path conditions held fixed). If accepted, this removes the sole blocker and extends the confirmed responsibility to the vote path. Preflight returned valid:true with the run close to its budget expiry.
